_comment: The Lego registry — the executable index of bricks. Seeded with the existing Studio validators. Every entry has hasValidator:true; registry.register() refuses anything without one. Paths in `dir` are relative to studio root. `run`/`validator` are run from `dir`. Capabilities with a per-game validator (gate, feel) take a game dir via --game (the dispatcher forwards it).

tools.name: sprite-studio
tools.inputs: a prompt or a generated sprite sheet (defaults to the bundled sample-hero sheet)

tools.name: contraptions
tools.inputs: a contraption type + params (cycles all registered types)

tools.name: eval-feel
tools.inputs: a game dir (scores window.LEVELS via the in-page Studio.Feel)

tools.name: game-gate
tools.inputs: a game dir (per-game 0-death gate: determinism + 0-death + non-black readback)

tools.name: studio-sound
tools.inputs: TODO: describe what the run step consumes
